name: UDR
notes: Researched from public udr.com pages (Resident Services, Bi-Weekly Payment Program, and one community's Lease Information FAQ - Legacy Village, Plano TX - used as a representative example; rules can vary by community). Payments in the UDR Resident app / residents.udr.com: ACH, money order, cashier's or personal check, credit card (extra fees may apply; amount not published, not modelled). No cash; payments are not accepted at the leasing office; mailed checks go certified to the St. Petersburg FL business office. Late after the 3rd: 10% late fee (example community). Bi-Weekly Payment Program: half on the 1st, half on the 15th, for a non-refundable monthly fee (amount not published), not at every community. 60-day written notice to move out. Resident Relations 855-465-2224, Mon-Fri 10-7 ET. Sign-in field labels not observed (JS app). REVIEW 2026-10-09 (independent reviewer): verified Resident Services, Bi-Weekly program page and the Legacy Village FAQ (raw FAQ JSON-LD). The non-refundable fee comes from the community FAQ, not the program page, so that article now cites the FAQ. guest_pay 'unsupported' is now evidence inferred (no page states it). Mail rule corrected: any check or money order sent by certified mail (not 'certified check').

pay_online.note: Pay through the UDR Resident app or Resident Login by ACH or credit card; card payments may carry extra fees.

guest_pay.note: No pay-without-login page is published and the leasing office does not take payments; use the UDR Resident app or mail a check or money order by certified mail.

cancel_service.note: Moving out requires at least 60 days' written notice to avoid extra fees.

pay_by_mail.note: Mail a check or money order by certified mail to the business office in St. Petersburg, FL, and email the tracking details to your community.

help.title: Paying rent
paragraphs: Rent is due on the 1st and is late after the 3rd. Pay in the UDR Resident app (or Resident Login) by ACH or credit card; ACH avoids the extra card fees. Money orders, cashier's checks and personal checks are also accepted, but cash is not.

The leasing office cannot take payments. Mailed checks or money orders go to the business office in St. Petersburg, Florida, by certified mail; email the tracking details to your community. Billing questions are handled by the community's business managers.

help.title: Bi-Weekly Payment Program
paragraphs: Split your rent in two: pay half on the 1st of the month and the other half on the 15th. UDR's program page says restrictions apply and it is not offered at every community; the example community's FAQ adds that it carries a non-refundable monthly fee (amount not published).

help.title: Late rent
paragraphs: Rent not paid by the end of the 3rd is late and a late fee of 10% of the overdue rent applies (this is the rule at the example community; check your lease).

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: Give at least 60 days' written notice before moving out to avoid additional fees. A transfer to another apartment needs at least 30 days' written notice. A voluntary lease buyout needs 30 days' written notice plus a fee of 200% of one month's rent, paid within 15 days of the notice.

help.title: Resident Relations
paragraphs: Current residents can reach Resident Relations at 855-465-2224, Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET. The UDR Resident app handles rent payments, service requests and community news; maintenance is available 24/7.

extra.intent: You want to split your UDR rent into two payments. Using the help pages, find on which day of the month the second half is paid under the Bi-Weekly Payment Program. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Half on the 1st and the other half on the 15th.
